tokens.name: color-paper
tokens.usage: Page background (bg-paper), like the inside of a study notebook. All body text sits on it.

tokens.name: color-surface
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, modals and outline buttons (bg-surface), raised off paper.

tokens.name: color-ink-900
tokens.usage: Primary text, headings and big Vietnamese words (text-ink-900); 11.7:1 on paper. Also the Toast and Tooltip fill. Never use pure black.

tokens.name: color-ink-700
tokens.usage: Form labels, body copy in dialogs, outline-button labels (text-ink-700); 7.6:1 on paper.

tokens.name: color-ink-500
tokens.usage: Muted text: descriptions, subtitles, ghost-button labels (text-ink-500). 4.25:1 on paper and 4.4:1 on surface, just under 4.5:1: keep it to secondary copy, 14px bold or larger.

tokens.name: color-ink-300
tokens.usage: Borders and placeholders only (border-ink-300, often at /60 or /20 opacity; placeholder:text-ink-300). 2.1:1: never for text that must be read.

tokens.name: color-red-50
tokens.usage: Danger-button face and red NavCard tile (bg-red-50).

tokens.name: color-red-100
tokens.usage: Red Badge ground, focus ring behind an errored input (ring-red-100), red tile hover.

tokens.name: color-red-200
tokens.usage: Danger-button bottom edge, red NavCard border (border-red-200).

tokens.name: color-red-300
tokens.usage: Soft red accent between the tints and the brand red.

tokens.name: color-red-400
tokens.usage: Primary-button hover face, red tile hover border.

tokens.name: color-red-500
tokens.usage: THE brand red: primary button face, Logo tile, Switch on, error borders, Again rating. White labels on it are 3.3:1 (below 4.5:1), as shipped.

tokens.name: color-red-600
tokens.usage: Red text: error messages, danger-button label, red Badge text. 4.4:1 on surface, 3.5:1 on red-100.

tokens.name: color-red-700
tokens.usage: Primary-button bottom edge (border-red-700), the darker face that makes it look raised.

tokens.name: color-yellow-50
tokens.usage: Hover wash on outline and ghost buttons; yellow NavCard tile.

tokens.name: color-yellow-100
tokens.usage: Tag pills, yellow Badge ground, focus ring around inputs (ring-yellow-100).

tokens.name: color-yellow-200
tokens.usage: Yellow NavCard border.

tokens.name: color-yellow-300
tokens.usage: Secondary-button hover face; Tooltip focus ring.

tokens.name: color-yellow-400
tokens.usage: THE brand yellow: secondary button face, Hard rating; ink-900 text on it (7.7:1).

tokens.name: color-yellow-500
tokens.usage: Focused input border (focus:border-yellow-500).

tokens.name: color-yellow-600
tokens.usage: Secondary-button bottom edge; yellow Badge text (2.2:1 on yellow-100, below 4.5:1, as shipped).

tokens.name: color-success
tokens.usage: Correct / Good: the Good rating face, green Badge tint (bg-success/15). White on it is 3.0:1.

tokens.name: color-success-dark
tokens.usage: Good-rating bottom edge and green Badge text.

tokens.name: color-sky-100
tokens.usage: Blue Badge ground (the New status). Tailwind's default sky, used as the app's only cool colour.

tokens.name: color-sky-400
tokens.usage: Easy rating face.

tokens.name: color-sky-600
tokens.usage: Easy rating bottom edge.

tokens.name: color-sky-700
tokens.usage: Blue Badge text.

styles.name: study-word
styles.usage: The Vietnamese term on a flashcard or detail view.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Modal titles and NavCard labels (text-xl font-extrabold).

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default running text and input values.
styles.sample: Tôi thích ăn phở vào buổi sáng.

styles.name: field-label
styles.usage: Form labels and section labels: uppercase, tracking-wide, ink-700.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Descriptions, helper and error text (text-sm font-semibold).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tailwind's 1 step (p-1, gap-1): the base unit of every spacing class.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Label-to-field gap inside form fields (gap-1.5).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between badges, pills and inline buttons (gap-2).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding (py-3) and gaps between buttons in a row (gap-3).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Input horizontal padding (px-4); gap between stacked fields (gap-4).

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Grid gap between dashboard tiles (gap-5); modal body padding (py-5).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card and modal padding (p-6, px-6), button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections (gap-8).

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Page top/bottom padding (py-10).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, tag fields, small buttons (rounded-xl).

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Buttons and rating buttons (rounded-2xl).

tokens.name: radius-3xl
tokens.usage: Cards, NavCard tiles, modals (rounded-3xl).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Badges, tag pills, Switch, Toast (rounded-full).

tokens.name: shadow-tile
tokens.usage: The flat 'raised' drop under NavCard tiles (shadow-[0_4px_0_rgba(74,47,34,0.06)]).
